snippet.title: Expendabots - Reveal Trailer | 4-Player Co-op Extraction Horror
snippet.description:
Expendabots is a 4-player cooperative horror extraction game where players control clunky but resourceful Expendabots scavenging procedurally generated islands. Expendabots rely on backpack 3D printers to to print gear on the fly 🤖🤖🤖🤖

🦾 Join the cause - Join Expendabots https://discord.gg/expendabots

😱 Expendabots launches on Steam for Windows and Mac later this year 💙 💚 ❤️ 💛
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3809820/Expendabots/
